Here is the precise UI/UX analysis of the property registration form, broken down by section.

### **Section 1: Owner Information**
*Icon: User silhouette*

| Field Label | Input Type | Width | Placeholder / Value | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Owner Name \*** | Text | **Full Width** | `Anna Kodjogah` | Required field (red asterisk) |
| **Owner Address** | Text | **Half Column (Left)** | *(Empty)* | |
| **Owner GhanaPost GPS** | Text | **Half Column (Right)** | `VP-0029-9748` | |
| **Phone \*** | Text | **1/3 Column (Left)** | `0544370388` | Required field |
| **Email** | Text | **1/3 Column (Center)** | *(Empty)* | |
| **TIN** | Text | **1/3 Column (Right)** | *(Empty)* | |
| **National ID** | Text | **Half Column (Left)** | *(Empty)* | |
| **Ownership Type** | Dropdown | **Half Column (Right)** | `Select type` | Chevron icon on right |

---

### **Section 2: Property Information**
*Icon: Building/Grid*

| Field Label | Input Type | Width | Placeholder / Value | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Property Use Type \*** | Dropdown | **1/3 Column (Left)** | `20121 : Residential : 3rd Class Residential : 420` | Required; long text value visible |
| **Value (GHS)** | Text/Number | **1/3 Column (Center)** | *(Empty)* | |
| **Rooms** | Text/Number | **1/3 Column (Right)** | `3` | |
| **Building Permit** | Radio Buttons | **Half Column (Left)** | `Yes` / `No` (Selected) | "No" is pre-selected (blue dot) |
| **Permit Number** | Text | **Half Column (Right)** | *(Empty)* | Conditionally active/disabled based on permit status |
| **Excluded from rating** | Checkbox | **Inline (Right of Permit Number)** | *(Unchecked)* | Placed to the right of the Permit Number input |
| **Comments** | Textarea | **Full Width** | `uploaded by submitDetailsRun.php` | Multi-line input with resize handle in corner |

---

### **Global Form Actions (Footer)**
*Positioned at bottom right, outside the cards.*

| Button Label | Style | Color | Icon |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cancel** | Outlined/Filled Dark | Slate Gray (`#5F6A7E`) | White 'X' icon |
| **Save** | Filled Primary | Orange (`#ED8B00`) | White Checkmark icon |

---

### **UI/UX Design Specifications for Recreation:**

*   **Layout Grid:** The form uses a responsive grid system. Most rows are split into halves (50%/50%), while the Phone/Email/TIN and Property Use/Value/Rooms rows are split into thirds (~33% each).
*   **Typography:** Labels use a medium-weight, dark gray sans-serif font. Input values use a standard weight.
*   **Spacing:** There is consistent vertical rhythm between rows (approx. 20px gap). Section headers have a light gray background bar spanning the full width of the card.
*   **Input Styling:** All inputs have a subtle border (light gray), rounded corners (approx. 4px radius), and internal padding. Focus states likely highlight with a blue or primary color border.
*   **Required Indication:** An asterisk (`*`) in red is used immediately after the label text for mandatory fields.
